home.aboutTitle: About Wolaita Sodo Water-Point Monitoring System
home.aboutDesc1: Wolaita Sodo Water-Point Monitoring System is a community-driven water infrastructure monitoring system designed for Wolaita Zone in South Ethiopia. It enables citizens to report broken or malfunctioning water points in real-time and helps local WASH offices track and resolve issues efficiently.
home.aboutDesc2: By working together, we can ensure that every community has access to clean, safe water.

about.pageSubtitle: Community water-point monitoring for Wolaita Zone, South Ethiopia
about.whatIsTitle: What is Wolaita Sodo Water-Point Monitoring System?
about.whatIsDesc: Wolaita Sodo Water-Point Monitoring System is a community water-point monitoring system designed specifically for Wolaita Zone in South Ethiopia. It enables citizens to report broken or malfunctioning water points in real-time and helps local WASH offices track and resolve issues efficiently.
about.problemDesc: Hand pumps and shallow wells across rural and peri-urban Ethiopia frequently break down and stay broken for months. The root problem is not usually technical — it is informational:
about.problemList1: No reliable way for community members to report broken water points
about.problemList2: Reports get lost or delayed through word-of-mouth
about.problemList3: No visibility into which water points need repair
about.problemList5: Communities forced back onto unsafe water sources
about.feature1Desc: Report a problem in under 1 minute with photo evidence
about.feature2Desc: Your report goes directly to the responsible WASH office
about.feature3Desc: Follow your report from submission to resolution
about.feature4Desc: See which water points are working and which need repair
about.feature5Desc: Offices can prioritize and track all reports in one place
about.coverageDesc: We currently cover water points across all woredas in Wolaita Zone, including Sodo Zuriya, Damot Gale, Damot Sore, Boloso Sore, and others.
about.techSupportInfo: Sunshine Tech Solution — Sodo, Wolaita, Ethiopia
about.getStartedDesc: Ready to help your community access clean water?
about.loTag: Lo — the Wolaytta word for ‘good’. Good water, for every community.
